wide_comparison.timing_scope: Full-1080p FP16 network plus output grade; no D3D12/application integration.
limitations: One scene, varied illumination and cameras; no cross-scene or temporal acceptance.
Two previous views already informed architecture choices. Four additional views were reserved before this comparison.
Pixel metrics do not establish preserved perceptual quality. No replacement is accepted.
Same-scene first-reset frames only; no temporal or cross-scene acceptance.
The four additional validation views were reserved before the initial comparison; their results subsequently informed the width-32 test.
Output grading reuses the prior observed constants under matched controls; the native scalar contract was not recaptured for each light.
Torch timings include the complete network and output grade but exclude application integration.
Three newly lit validation views improve for the plain model; older north and new neutral worsen. No quality gate is passed.
The larger model improves training fit but worsens all four new validation MAEs. It is not accepted.
